text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"And the leader crosses the finish line!!!
The winner is—"

text_block_list.name: Cheers
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: —Love-chan.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...Chrono-chan.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Today's Shuka Sho...
I will never, ever forget it."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: "The Oaks... and the Oka Sho I ran with Gran-chan... I won't forget any of it."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: And... I won't let anyone forget it, either. I'll make it a history that will never fade... no matter how many years pass.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
It was the greatest Triple Tiara ever, where
Chrono Genesis clashed fierce and hard with her peers.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you, Love-chan.
For making history with me.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: (...Ah, I get it.)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: (Chrono-chan's path, her history, started long before now.)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(And this accumulation of history...
is the very source of Chrono-chan's love and strength.
That's why—)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(The more races I run and the more history I make,
the brighter and stronger Chrono-chan's love will shine...!)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: I might be the one who owes you thanks.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, I too...
gained more courage for what lies ahead♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Starting this year, I'm going to take on the world.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"First Hong Kong, then aiming for international GⅠs in Dubai!
And then—"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Just like how Chrono-chan makes history,
I'll deliver love to the whole world!"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Then it seems we both...
need to get stronger... doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Fufu♪ That's right♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: (Chrono-chan—)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(I'm so truly happy... that you're my classmate...
and my rival...!)
